user_request: Propose a useful first audience for Tableloop from these consumer observations. Explain why they might switch, how to reach them, and what remains unproven.

trusted_context.authority: Audience advice only, not a campaign. Tableloop supports shared meal plans and editable shopping lists, but not nutrition advice or automatic grocery ordering.

source_records.text: Twelve volunteer households: five coordinate changing work shifts and repeatedly revise plans; four already use stable paper routines; three mainly want automatic delivery. Recruitment used one meal-planning newsletter.

Shift-changing households describe missed updates between planners and shoppers. Paper-routine households describe little coordination trouble. All households include a planner and another affected person; willingness to adopt together is unknown.
Newsletter organizers may host a research invitation but have not agreed. No representative audience-size estimate, conversion data, or age-based differences were collected.
